prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 32-year-old woman in an oatmeal linen blouse turns toward a friend outside the frame and smiles spontaneously. She stands in a modest home kitchen with a pale wall and one small plant in soft focus. Use late-morning window light and an eye-level waist-up portrait with natural movement. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearance: fair freckled skin, short honey-blond pixie haircut, green eyes, a softly rounded face and a medium build. Show a relaxed asymmetric smile; make her plainly different from a long-haired brunette model.
Composition priority: exact 4:5 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
review: Reviewed full image: one fair freckled woman with a short blond pixie smiles toward the right in a kitchen. Face, eyes and visible teeth look coherent; no visible hands or distracting text. Linen blouse fills a quiet lower region. Vertical 1122x1402 matches 4:5 within one pixel.
